brief:
Ireland beat Israel 3-0 in a UEFA Nations League match played in Hungary, according to Al Jazeera English. The Irish team wore black armbands during the fixture in a show of solidarity with Gaza.

The match carried political significance amid the ongoing conflict in the region. The game took place under heightened scrutiny given the tensions between the two nations and international debate surrounding the Gaza situation.
dek: Ireland scored a 3-0 victory over Israel in a politically-charged UEFA Nations League match played in Hungary.
title: Ireland defeats Israel 3-0 in politically charged UEFA match
